answer: The bedrock check is Starchartmaker plate trial attested before the eclipse tally. Under it sits 5-year night-watch service, 189 supervised sightings, night-watch exam, annual tally, and no template can dig around it. The price of one fake is 95 POA and 18 minutes; the price of 679 fakes is 64505 POA and 12222 minutes. The harbor is the signature, the trellis is the fee, and the plume is the register where both are written down. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
